units.source_zh: 不到半刻，夏目正吉连同二十五人都去了另一个世界。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十五骑武士一起冲入敌阵中。不到半刻，夏目正吉连同二十五人都去了另一个世界。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu halted before the great camphor tree at Hamamatsu Hachiman Shrine. By then he was utterly exhausted, and his warhorse was shivering in the cold wind. He dismounted and rested for a moment, then entered Hamamatsu Castle with a blank expression. The battle had been, in every sense, a crushing defeat.

units.source_en: He dismounted and rested for a moment, then entered Hamamatsu Castle with a blank expression.
units.source_zh: 他下马歇息了片刻，然后面无表情地进了滨松城。

units.source_zh: 这一战，可以说是一败涂地。

paragraphs.source_en: Only Takagi Kyūsuke was still shouting in the darkness, “Takagi Kyūsuke has taken the head of Shingen, commander of the Takeda! Our lord has returned to the castle. Open the gate!”

paragraphs.source_en: Whirling snowflakes shrouded the city of tragedy.
